title: East Uusimaa: 0.3 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €15,600 a year
markdown:
# East Uusimaa: 0.3 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €15,600 a year

> 0.3 more patients a year treated to cure · €15,600 of €1.00M · €984,400 left: nothing else pays off at these assumptions

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in East Uusimaa, 28 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. The difference is within what chance alone gives a county of this size. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties, where 30.4 in 100 are treated to cure, about 1.1 patients a year are missing (range 0.0–4.0). [^care_curative] [^model] Against Finland as a whole there is no measured shortfall to split between surgery and radiotherapy. [^model]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 28.3% to 28.8% by 2028: 0.3 more patients a year (range 0.0–0.6), for €15,600 a year, about €58,000 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment**[^ev_prehab_fitness_assessment_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; leads of rehabilitation and geriatrics | €15,600 | 0.3 (0.0–0.6) | Decide that no stage I-III patient is recorded as "not fit" without an exercise test, and book the physiotherapy group. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 28.3% → 28.8% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€15,600** | **0.3 (0.0–0.6)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €318,752 a year; modelled to avoid 0.5 deaths a year (0.1–1.4). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 28.3% (2019–2023, measured) → 28.8% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

€15,600 buys every measure that adds patients treated to cure here. [^model] The remaining €984,400 buys nothing more in the model: the limit is the reachable part of the measured shortfall, not money. [^model] More could come from low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or from ranking measures by deaths avoided. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 48 deaths a year in East Uusimaa, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.0 of them (range 0.0–0.2). [^deaths] [^model]

## Limits

- Effects are assumptions, not trial results. The range runs from every assumption at its lowest to every one at its highest, and it is not a probability. [^model]
- The expected share is adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage, fitness, histology, smoking or how the cancer was found. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- The estimated symptom-to-treatment clock is not used here. A check against measured outcomes found it matched none of 3 outcomes beyond chance; this is a check, not a validation. [^model]

flagged.reason: Carried a number without a source marker; the supporting id (model, plan saturation note) is obvious, so [^model] was added.

flagged.sentence: The remaining €984,400 buys nothing more: the limit is the reachable part of the measured shortfall, not money. [^model]
flagged.reason: Presented a model result as fact; the source says it buys nothing more 'in the model'. Added 'in the model'.

flagged.sentence: Shares are adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage, fitness, histology, smoking or how the cancer was found. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
flagged.reason: The measured shares are not adjusted; only the expected share (27.2%) is adjusted for the share of residents aged 65+. Reworded to 'The expected share is adjusted'.

flagged.sentence: The estimated symptom-to-treatment clock is not used here. A check against measured outcomes confirmed it for 0 of 3 outcomes. [^model]
flagged.reason: 'Confirmed' implies validation; the source says 0 of 3 outcomes correlate in the expected direction beyond chance and that this is a check, not a validation. Reworded accordingly.
